resources.string: Audio output changed during recovery. Start playback again.
Sound and picture formats
Nuvio Arc\'s handling of TrueHD, DTS-HD, Atmos, surround and Dolby Vision. Built-in player only.
Arc format handling
Lossless passthrough for TrueHD and DTS-HD, surround matched to your audio system, and Arc\'s recovery when a receiver refuses a format. Off plays sound exactly as Nuvio does.
System passthrough
Sends TrueHD and DTS-HD to your receiver through Android instead of the app\'s IEC path. Use this if lossless formats produce noise, drift or no audio.
Surround format
Auto (recommended)
Passes through the formats your audio system reports it can decode, and decodes the rest in the app.
Manual
Choose per format whether your audio system can decode it. Use this when the automatic report is wrong.
Sound goes through the TV to a soundbar (ARC)
Converts formats the soundbar cannot take to Dolby Digital 5.1 and sends other decoded sound as stereo. Dolby Digital and Dolby Digital Plus pass through untouched.
Dolby Digital (AC-3) capable receiver
Off decodes AC-3 to PCM in the app. Turn off only if your receiver or TV cannot decode AC-3.
Dolby Digital Plus (E-AC-3) capable receiver
Covers DD+ and DD+ Atmos. Off decodes to PCM. Turn off only if your receiver cannot decode Dolby Digital Plus.
Dolby TrueHD capable receiver
Covers TrueHD and TrueHD Atmos. Off decodes to PCM and loses Atmos. Turn off only if your receiver cannot decode TrueHD.
DTS capable receiver
Off decodes DTS to PCM. Turn off if your receiver or TV cannot decode DTS; some TVs no longer license it.
DTS-HD capable receiver
Covers DTS-HD MA, HRA and DTS:X. Off decodes to PCM and loses DTS:X. Turn off if your receiver handles DTS but not DTS-HD.
Transcode switched-off formats to AC-3
Re-encodes the formats switched off above to Dolby Digital 5.1 instead of PCM. For receivers limited to 2-channel PCM; leave off if yours takes multichannel PCM.
Decode channel target
Channel layout for audio the app decodes. Auto follows what your audio system reports.
Auto
2.0 Stereo
Your audio decoder is set to device only in Playback settings, so the app cannot decode or convert formats.
Test lossless passthrough again
Tests IEC 61937 output again. Use this if TrueHD or DTS-HD fall back to PCM after changing receiver or input.
Checking lossless passthrough
Lossless passthrough opened. TrueHD and DTS-HD will be sent on this connection.
Lossless passthrough is not available on this connection. TrueHD and DTS-HD use your device default instead.
Forget learned audio refusals
Formats your receiver refused to open are not sent to it as passthrough. This lets them be tried again.
Nothing learned
Learned audio refusals cleared
Forget tunnel stalls
Tunnel off for: %1$s. Lets the next video try tunnelling again.
Nothing remembered
Tunnel stalls forgotten
Add HDR10 metadata when Dolby Vision is stripped

For Dolby Vision Profile 8 played as its HDR10 base layer, adds the source\'s mastering metadata (MaxCLL, MaxFALL and peak brightness) so HDR10 TVs tone-map correctly. Only active when DV handling in Playback settings is Strip DV or HDR10 base layer.
